title: 지방교육행정기관의 행정기구와 정원기준 등에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 지방교육행정기관의 행정기구와 정원기준 등에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Rule No. 1, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>

Articles 2 through 6
Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (47) Omitted.

(48) The Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on Organizations and Personnel Standards of Local Educational Administrative Agencies shall be partially amended as follows:

In the part of Article 4 preceding its subparagraphs, Article 5 (1) through (3), the part of Article 5 (4) preceding its subparagraphs, and Article 5 (5), "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced in each instance with "Minister of Education".

(49) through (61) Omitted.
